# Embodied First Exam

<p>
  <a href="https://www.embodied-first-exam.ai"><img src="docs/assets/badge-website.svg" alt="Website: embodied-first-exam.ai" height="36"></a>
  <a href="https://discord.gg/TvscHrhDt"><img src="docs/assets/badge-discord.svg" alt="Discord" height="36"></a>
</p>

Code agents have passed many exams in the digital world.<br>
**What is their first exam to enter the physical world?**

Robot tasks for code agents (Claude Code, Codex, …) in the [Harbor](https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor) task format.

## Quick start

<!-- quick-start: generated by `python3 scripts/task_conventions.py readme --write` -->
```bash
git clone --recurse-submodules git@github.com:mll-lab-nu/embodied-first-exam.git && cd embodied-first-exam
uv tool install --force -e . --with-executables-from harbor                            # harbor 0.23.0 with the flags below
cp .env.example .env                                                                   # API keys

harbor run -d embodied-first-exam -a codex -m openai/gpt-6-astra                       # core: 449 tasks, each in its default mode
harbor run -d embodied-first-exam --privileged -a codex -m openai/gpt-6-astra          # core in another mode: 372 privileged (also --standard / --standard-realtime)
harbor run -d embodied-first-exam@all -a codex -m openai/gpt-6-astra                   # all: 2128 task dirs (1090 tasks x their modes)
harbor run -d embodied-first-exam@all -p tasks/roboarc -a codex -m openai/gpt-6-astra  # one benchmark: RoboARC, 196 task dirs
harbor run -d embodied-first-exam@all -p tasks/<benchmark>/<task> -a oracle            # one task

codex login                                                                            # or a ChatGPT subscription instead of the API key
CODEX_FORCE_AUTH_JSON=1 harbor run -d embodied-first-exam -a codex -m openai/gpt-6-astra
claude setup-token                                                                     # or a Claude subscription: its token as CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN in .env
CLAUDE_FORCE_OAUTH=1 harbor run -d embodied-first-exam -a claude-code -m anthropic/claude-opus-5-5
```
<!-- /quick-start -->
